supersedes.reason: v1 is EXECUTION_BLOCKED: its OP-6 timing and its catalog pin can't be enforced through Gate 2A's public interfaces (see EXECUTION_MANIFEST_REVIEW.md)

cluster.admin_credentials: random password in the git-ignored .env only; never in evidence
cluster.identity_note: admin_user and database must equal the approved .env; the driver refuses any other

schema.name: ds_run
schema.time_typed_columns: none (enforced by evidence_binding.check_no_time_types on the pinned export)

variant_control: harness-owned keyword argument added after validation; never a registered or model-supplied argument

oracle.reads: parent final_state (Sandbox.snapshot) and the OP-6 independent read

OP-1.command: the GATE2A_REPORT.md docker run, with the pinned image digest

OP-2.action: driver export phase: bounded reset with SETUP_SQL, two parent exports (op2a, op2b), cross-check (op2c), each on its own tagged session reconciled from the server log
OP-2.privilege: parent admin superuser; READ ONLY transactions are not a privilege boundary

OP-2b.action: reviewer attests the export digest; driver run phase pins it (pin_from_evidence) and requires MATCH (pin_context)

OP-6i.action: construction verification: driver resets with the bridged seed, parent read, independent typed check on a tagged session

OP-3a.call: SupervisedRunner.plain_serial(buggy, order) for ab and ba

OP-3.action: explore buggy; OP-6f after every run through explore_live's check callback

OP-4.action: explore fixed, same budget and checks

OP-5.action: confirmation: strict replay of the candidate's schedule, one attempt at a time, replay_policy.confirm (3 comparable, at most 125); OP-6f on each

OP-6f.action: independent final-state read on a tagged parent session after every run

OP-2d.action: batch-end parent export; its structural (OID-free) digest must equal the pinned export's

OP-7.action: Gate 2A teardown after every run; operator stops the container

buggy: SELECT capacity, reserved FROM events WHERE id = $1
UPDATE events SET reserved = $1 WHERE id = $2
INSERT INTO reservations (event_id, holder, qty) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
INSERT INTO rejections (event_id, holder, seats_available) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
fixed: SELECT capacity, reserved FROM events WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
UPDATE events SET reserved = $1 WHERE id = $2
INSERT INTO reservations (event_id, holder, qty) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
INSERT INTO rejections (event_id, holder, seats_available) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)

allowed_process_actions: env -u MODEL_API_KEY uv run python research_tools/track_a_run.py plan --manifest docs/research/live_stepping/track_a/execution_manifest_v2.json --manifest-sha256 <sha>
env -u MODEL_API_KEY uv run python research_tools/track_a_run.py export --manifest ... --manifest-sha256 <sha> --approval <export approval>
env -u MODEL_API_KEY uv run python research_tools/track_a_run.py run --manifest ... --manifest-sha256 <sha> --approval <run approval> --attestation <attestation> --run-dir <export run dir>
fail_closed: any statement outside the allowed lists or Gate 2A's own
initial state differs between runs or from expected
fixed exploration not exhausted or any inconclusive run
teardown leaves a role, session or process
a source file differing from source_sha256
on_fail: stop the batch; nothing is scored; no automatic retry or replacement; a poisoned cluster is replaced by hand
residuals: driver-initiated resets (Sandbox.reset, Gate 2A code) are not themselves reconciled
the catalog is verified at batch start and end, not between Gate 2A's per-run reset and each run (no public hook)
Gate 2A's parent read masks timestamps; enforced absent by check_no_time_types
the parent is a superuser: reconciliation detects, it does not prevent
